annotations.title: Find DePIN networks by name or ticker

description: Looks up DePIN networks (and Bittensor subnets) that have live data, by name or ticker, e.g. 'akash', 'helium', 'FIL'. Returns symbol, name, category and the network's public page. Use it to get the symbol that get_network, get_metric_history and verify_value take. Read-only, no key.

category.description: Optional category filter, e.g. compute, storage, wireless, AI.

query.description: Name or ticker fragment, case-insensitive. Omit to list.

name: find_networks
title: Find DePIN networks by name or ticker
